title: Zoom reports Q3 revenue up 4.9% YoY to $1.29B, above $1.28B est., enterprise revenue up 8.6% to $805.4M, and forecasts Q4 revenue below estimates (Brody Ford/Bloomberg)
summary: Brody Ford / Bloomberg: Zoom reports Q3 revenue up 4.9% YoY to $1.29B, above $1.28B est., enterprise revenue up 8.6% to $805.4M, and forecasts Q4 revenue below estimates — Zoom Communications Inc. gave a revenue forecast for the current quarter that at the midpoint fell just short of analysts' estimates …
